speaker: Keisha Ramos
cascadeSummary: Phase II site remediation begins per council directives with independent oversight. Mobilized contractors will execute soil handling protocols while workforce pipelines activate local hires.

statements.decision: Remediation crews deployed to site with independent audit protocols active
statements.quote: Thirty-eight thousand tons of certified clean fill arrive Tuesday — Baylight's foundation is literally being laid.
statements.fullStatement: Baylight Authority Director Keisha Ramos confirmed Phase II site remediation commenced this morning with three crews deploying per BD-83-REB protocols. Independent oversight auditors from CRC are tracking soil handling metrics in real-time. The workforce pipeline has activated 47 local hires through the Building Trades Council, with 22 more in training.

trackerUpdates.MilestoneNotes: C109: Phase II remediation commenced with independent oversight

statements.decision: 24/7 construction hotline established for Elmhurst residents
statements.quote: The construction fence has our number — call about dust, noise, or truck routes and it gets handled.
statements.fullStatement: The Baylight Authority has activated a dedicated construction response line (510-555-BAYL) for Coliseum-area residents. Elmhurst community liaison Carmen Ruiz will coordinate same-day resolution for any remediation-related impacts. Truck routes avoid school zones during drop-off/pick-up times per the community advisory agreement.
